reason: Root cause: #1009's _sp_front kept the indexer head weights rank-local in every sequence-parallel forward (attention.py:1276, index_weights[: sp_rows.real_rows]), but _forward splits the indexer by rank only in a step with prefill rows (attention.py:1514-1515: split is None when swa.is_decode). In an SP decode step every rank scores all T rows, and _index_query (attention.py:1617-1622) took index_weights[0:T] of the L local rows, so the scorer got T query rows and L weight rows. The tp4-ring warm-up's first eager tail shape past the capture limit, T=214 (16 requests of 13-14 rows, within the copy-draft decode threshold of 17), is past the SP threshold of 205 and is such a step: L=54, 'expected: 64, got: 54'. Fix: _sp_front reads the step's SWA metadata first and keeps the weights local only where _forward splits the indexer; in a decode step (and under _INDEX_SPLIT_CHECK, as before) it gathers them with sp_rows.gather. Steps with prefill rows are unchanged: same kernels, same collectives, byte-identical outputs. Reproduced on one GPU through vLLM's own TileLang attention at TP4 rank shapes (the exact error at rank 0), and at TP3 (got: 8) and TP8 (got: 27); the corrected tree passes every step at TP3, TP4 and TP8 and is byte-identical to candidate-50 without #1009 on every rank, two boots plus a final run. The own mark holds: by CUDA-graph replay and by CUPTI kernel time, same-session ABBA against candidate-50 without #1009, all 6 cells faster beyond the two-boot interval (5.0x-24.5x), none slower; #1009's own bench reproduces its gains and 0 differing bytes.

TP4: L = 54.
root_cause.why_tp3_booted: Derived, not measured: tp3's sizing (max_num_seqs 8, decode rows 59) makes its first tail shape past the SP threshold 236 rows in 8 requests of 29-30 rows, a step with prefill rows, so candidate-49's tp3-switched boot never ran an SP decode step. The harness shows the first version fails an SP decode step at TP3 rank shapes too. tp4-switched and tp8-switched take tp4-ring's sizing and would run the same T=214 step (TP8: L=27, the harness's 'got: 27').
